NOTICE OF CANCELLATION 
AVISO DE CANCELACIÓN 
 
Notice is hereby given, in accordance with Section 2.081(c) of the Texas Election Code, that the following elections, which 
were scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026 have been canceled. Any provided copy of each Order of Cancellation 
by the respective authority for the elections applicable to this polling place is attached hereto and/or is placed for public 
viewing at the voter check-in table.
